reason: The panel has an empty essential-power slot, and the immediate goal is to switch to reserve.
expectation: The panel will select the charged reserve for essential power.

effect: Essential power is selected, and the exterior circuits now need to be made safe.
reaction: The separate indicators make the shutdown sequence clearer.
reason: The panel has a well isolation and drainage slot, and the insulated water line identifies the exterior well circuit.
expectation: The panel will isolate and drain the exterior well line.

effect: The well line is confirmed drained and its trace heating is off; the fuel fab still needs shutdown.
reaction: The sequence of draining before switching off heat makes practical sense.
reason: The panel has a fuel-fab shutdown slot, and the running fuel fab is the remaining exterior system to secure.
expectation: The panel will shut down the fuel fab safely.

effect: The fuel fab is safely cooled and isolated, completing the storm preparations; some stored propellant remains, while boil-off vents separately.
reaction: The controlled shutdown and acknowledgement of boil-off made the outcome feel physically grounded.

mostWorthwhile.text: Draining the well line before switching off its trace heating was worthwhile: the sequence explained how the exterior circuit was protected.

leastWorthwhile.text: Selecting reserve power was a straightforward panel-slot match, with less to figure out than the subsequent shutdown sequences.

surprise.text: The cold tanks retain some liquid but vent boil-off during shutdown, a useful reminder that stopping production does not eliminate refrigeration concerns.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each matched a named panel control and had a clear safety purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how the station recovers after the storm; the practical shutdown details made that outcome interesting.
